> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `sign: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance sign <id>
provenance sign <command>
```

Record an electronic signature — identity, timestamp, meaning and re-authentication — against the current state of the entity or change request/ECO identified by id.

Prompts for the configured signing provider (OIDC/SSO device-flow login, or a local platform certificate signature) and writes the resulting cryptographic proof to the signature ledger in `.signatures/`.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`sign verify`]({{< relref "sign-verify.md" >}}) | Check signature records against the content they sign |
